headline: CHW @ DET matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CHW 4.28 at DET 4.88, with a projected total of 9.16. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CHW: CHW moved +0.58 runs while DET moved +0.12, changing the projected margin by +0.46 runs. The projected total climbed +0.70, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +5.0%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Keider Montero has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Dillon Dingler, Sam Antonacci, Chase Meidroth, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jahmai Jones, Jacob Gonzalez because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
